data.name: Query_GetTimeSheetStatus
data.value:
select @sDate = @month, @eDate = @month
;with cte as ( select convert(date,left(convert(varchar,@sdate,112),6) + '01') startDate, month(@sdate) n union all select dateadd(month,n,convert(date,convert(varchar,year(@sdate)) + '0101')) startDate, (n+1) n from cte where n < month(@sdate) + datediff(month,@sdate,@edate) ) select @sDate=startdate, @eDate=dateadd(day,-1,dateadd(month,1,startdate))
from cte Select TAB.FullName, TAB.FatherName,
TAB.EmployeeCode,
TAB.PersonID ,TAB.LeavelID ,TAB.PayrollTypeID ,TAB.PayrollTypeCode ,TAB.Description as LeaveTypeName
--, cast (isnull (TAB.leaveDays - SUM(QUANTITY),0 ) as int) as Balance ,TAB.LeaveDays --, cast( isnull( SUM(TAB.Quantity),0) as int) AS Quantity
,cast( isnull( SUM(TAB.MonthlyQuantity),0) as int)as Quantity
--,cast( isnull( SUM(TAB.LeaveTillMonth),0) as int)as LeaveTillMonth
,TAB.leaveDays - cast( isnull( SUM(TAB.LeaveTillMonth),0) as int) as Balance
from ( select distinct HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays ,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID , HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID ,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID ,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode ,HRMS_PayrollType.Description ,isnull(sum(HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Quantity),0) as Quantity, 0 As MonthlyQuantity, 0 As LeaveTillMonth
from HRMS_EmployeePayroll
left join HRMS_EmployeeAttendance on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.LeaveID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1 and( cast (HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.MonthYear as datetime) between @fromdate AND '31-dec-'+cast(datepart(yyyy,getdate()) as varchar))
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID= HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.[Status] = 1
inner JOIN HRMS_Set_Employee ON HRMS_EmployeePayRoll.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_EmployeePayRoll.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID
WHERE HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = @CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID=30 AND HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = 4
group by HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID ,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID ,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID , HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode ,HRMS_PayrollType.Description
union all
--CASE 0 Select HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID as PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description,
isnull (sum(DATEDIFF(dd,HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate,HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate) + 1),0) as Quantity,
(select
isnull (sum(DATEDIFF(dd,u.FromDate,u.ToDate) + 1),0)
from HRMS_LeaveRequest u where u.CompanyID = 1 and u.Fk_PersonID =HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and u.FromDate >= @sDate and u.FromDate <= @eDate) As MonthlyQuantity,
(select
isnull (sum(DATEDIFF(dd,u.FromDate,u.ToDate) + 1),0)
from HRMS_LeaveRequest u where u.CompanyID = 1 and u.Fk_PersonID =HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and u.FromDate >= DATEADD(yy, DATEDIFF(yy,0,getdate()), 0) and u.ToDate <= @eDate) As LeaveTillMonth
from HRMS_LeaveRequest
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1
inner JOIN HRMS_Set_Employee ON HRMS_EmployeePayRoll.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_EmployeePayRoll.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID
where HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode = 4
and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate >= @fromdate and HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate <= '31-dec-'+cast(datepart(yyyy,getdate()) as varchar)) --and (datepart(yyyy,HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate) = datepart(yyyy,@fromdate) ) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=@IsActive
group by HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID
union
--CASE 1 Select HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID as PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, isnull( sum(DATEDIFF(dd,@FromDate,HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate) + 1),0) as Quantity,
(select
isnull (sum(DATEDIFF(dd,u.FromDate,u.ToDate) + 1),0)
from HRMS_LeaveRequest u where u.CompanyID = 1 and u.Fk_PersonID =HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and u.FromDate >= @sDate and u.FromDate <= @eDate) As MonthlyQuantity, (select
isnull (sum(DATEDIFF(dd,u.FromDate,u.ToDate) + 1),0)
from HRMS_LeaveRequest u where u.CompanyID = 1 and u.Fk_PersonID =HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and u.FromDate >= DATEADD(yy, DATEDIFF(yy,0,getdate()), 0) and u.ToDate <= @eDate) As LeaveTillMonth
from HRMS_LeaveRequest
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1
inner JOIN HRMS_Set_Employee ON HRMS_EmployeePayRoll.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_EmployeePayRoll.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID
where HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode = 4
and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate < @FromDate and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate between @FromDate and '31-dec-'+cast(datepart(yyyy,getdate()) as varchar))) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=@IsActive
group by HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID
union
--CASE 2 Select HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID as PersonID,
HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description,
isnull( sum(DATEDIFF(dd,HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate,'31-dec-'+cast(datepart(yyyy,getdate()) as varchar)) + 1),0) as Quantity, --'0' as Quantity (select
isnull (sum(DATEDIFF(dd,u.FromDate,u.ToDate) + 1),0)
from HRMS_LeaveRequest u where u.CompanyID = 1 and u.Fk_PersonID =HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and u.FromDate >= @sDate and u.ToDate <= @eDate)As MonthlyQuantity,
(select
isnull (sum(DATEDIFF(dd,u.FromDate,u.ToDate) + 1),0)
from HRMS_LeaveRequest u where u.CompanyID = 1 and u.Fk_PersonID =HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and u.FromDate >= DATEADD(yy, DATEDIFF(yy,0,getdate()), 0) and u.ToDate <= @eDate) As LeaveTillMonth from HRMS_LeaveRequest
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1
inner JOIN HRMS_Set_Employee ON HRMS_EmployeePayRoll.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_EmployeePayRoll.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID
where HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode = 4
and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate > '31-dec-'+cast(datepart(yyyy,getdate()) as varchar) and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate between @FromDate and '31-dec-'+cast(datepart(yyyy,getdate()) as varchar))) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=@IsActive
group by HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID
union
--CASE 3 Select HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays,
HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeavelID, HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID as PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description,
isnull( sum(DATEDIFF(dd,@FromDate,'31-dec-'+cast(datepart(yyyy,getdate()) as varchar)) + 1),0) as Quantity, --'0' as Quantity (select
isnull (sum(DATEDIFF(dd,u.FromDate,u.ToDate) + 1),0)
from HRMS_LeaveRequest u where u.CompanyID = 1 and u.Fk_PersonID =HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and u.FromDate >= @sDate and u.FromDate <= @eDate)As MonthlyQuantity, (select
isnull (sum(DATEDIFF(dd,u.FromDate,u.ToDate) + 1),0)
from HRMS_LeaveRequest u where u.CompanyID = 1 and u.Fk_PersonID =HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and u.FromDate >= DATEADD(yy, DATEDIFF(yy,0,getdate()), 0) and u.ToDate <= @eDate) As LeaveTillMonth from HRMS_LeaveRequest
inner join HRMS_EmployeePayroll on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_PayrollType.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1
inner JOIN HRMS_Set_Employee ON HRMS_EmployeePayRoll.PersonID = HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_EmployeePayRoll.CompanyID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID
where HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeCode = 4
and (HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate < @FromDate and HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate >'31-dec-'+cast(datepart(yyyy,getdate()) as varchar)) and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[Status]=1 and HRMS_LeaveRequest.[IsApproved]=@IsActive
group by HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName,HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName,HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PersonID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID, HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode, HRMS_PayrollType.Description, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.leaveDays, HRMS_LeaveRequest.CompanyID
) as TAB --where -- TAB.PersonID=30 Group By TAB.FullName, TAB.FatherName, TAB.EmployeeCode, TAB.PersonID, TAB.LeavelID, TAB.PayrollTypeID, TAB.PayrollTypeCode, TAB.[Description], TAB.leaveDays, TAB.MonthlyQuantity, TAB.LeaveTillMonth

data.name: Query_GetTMSActiveDateWithLeaves
data.value:
SELECT distinct fintab.TheDate, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,EmployeeCode,FullName,DesignationName,DepartmentName,ShiftName,
ShiftTimeIN as STimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT as STimeOUT,
MIN(TMSTimeIN) as ETimeIN,MAX(TMSTimeOUT) as ETimeOUT,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 'Early In' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 'On Time' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' else '--' end + case when DataTypeIN='*' then '*' else '' end + ' / ' + case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 'Early Out' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeOUT then 'On Time' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then 'Late Out' else '--' end + case when DataTypeOUT='*' then '*' else '' end as AttStatus, case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) else '----' end as Time_IN, case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) else '----' end as Time_OUT,
case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 and MAX(LR.ShortLeaveType) is null then case when MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) is not null then MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) else 'L' end
when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 and count(LR.ShortLeaveType)> 0 then case when MAX(LR.ShortLeaveType) = 1 then 'L.A' when MAX(LR.ShortLeaveType) = 4 then 'C.H' when MAX(LR.ShortLeaveType) = 5 then 'S.H' when MAX(LR.ShortLeaveType) = 6 then 'I.L' when MAX(LR.ShortLeaveType) = 2 then 'E.R' when MAX(LR.ShortLeaveType) = 3 then 'B.R'
end
else case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.[DayDescription] = 'Sunday' and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null then 'W/O' when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G.H' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' else 'A' end end as [Status]
from (
SELECT SET_DateTime.TheDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,ED.DesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName, SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription,SET_DateTime.Reason, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.[Description] as ShiftName,
case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) as STimeOUT
from SET_DateTime
INNER JOIN HRMS_Set_Employee EP on ( EP.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID is null) and (EP.CompanyID in (@CompanyID)) and EP.Status = 1 and EP.IsActive = 1 left JOIN SET_Designation ED ON ED.DesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1 left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1
left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
where SET_DateTime.TheDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND EP.PersonTypeCode = @PersonType ) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on -- PT.CompanyID=LR.CompanyID and PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1 and PT.IsActive = 1
group by TheDate, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,EmployeeCode,FullName,DesignationName,DepartmentName, IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,Reason,ShiftName, DataTypeIN,DataTypeOUT, ShiftTimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT, STimeIN,STimeOUT
Order by PersonID,TheDate

data.name: Query_TMSForRegister
data.value:
SELECT fintab.TheDate,convert(varchar(2),TheDate,106)as NewDate, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then convert ( varchar(3), fintab.DayDescription ) else convert (varchar(3), datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) ) end as ShortDay_Name ,datename(month,fintab.TheDate) Month_Name, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,DepartmentName ,ShiftName ,STimeIN ,STimeOUT ,MIN(TMSTimeIN) as ETimeIN ,MAX(TMSTimeOUT) as ETimeOUT ,SectionName ,LocationName ,fintab.JoiningDate ,case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOUT then cast( convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, MAX(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':' +convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, MAX(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60)+':' +convert(varchar(5),(DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, MAX(TMSTimeOUT))%60)) as datetime) else cast( '00:00' as datetime) end as OverTime, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 'Early In' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 'On Time' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' else '--' end + case when DataTypeIN='*' then '*' else '' end + ' / ' + case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 'Early Out' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeOUT then 'On Time' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then 'Late Out' else '--' end + case when DataTypeOUT='*' then '*' else '' end as AttStatus,
case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) else '----' end as Time_IN, case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) else '----' end as Time_OUT, case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID)>0 then 'L' else case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Description = 'Sunday' and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null then 'W/O' when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G.H' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' else 'A' end end as Status,TerminalNo,
count(LR.LeaveRequestID) as CountLeave, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 1 when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 1 else 0 end as CountPresent, case when (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null) AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID)=0 then 1 else 0 end as CountAbsent,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInEarly, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) = STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInOnTime, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInLate,
case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutEarly, case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) = STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutOnTime, case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutLate
from (
SELECT SET_DateTime.Reason, SET_DateTime.Description, EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,ED.DesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName, SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.[Description] as ShiftName,
case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as STimeOUT,ETMS1.TerminalNo from SET_DateTime inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) {1} and EP.Status=1 left JOIN SET_Designation ED ON ED.DesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
--left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID=1 and SS.Status=1 --left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ES.ShiftID=SS.ShiftID and ES.PersonID = 12 and ES.Status=1
left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1 left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1
left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate {0} ) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on PT.CompanyID=LR.CompanyID and PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1
left join Set_Section on Set_Section.SectionID = fintab.FK_SectionID and Set_Section.Status =1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = fintab.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 {2} group by TheDate, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,DepartmentName, IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,ShiftName,
DataTypeIN,DataTypeOUT,
STimeIN,STimeOUT,fintab.TerminalNo,SectionName,LocationName,fintab.JoiningDate ,fintab.Reason, fintab.Description,ShiftTimeIN,ShiftTimeOut
Order by TheDate,EmployeeCode,Month_Name

data.name: Query_TMS_Absentees
data.value:
select case when fintab2.CountAbsent = 1 then 'Absent' when fintab2.CountInLate = 1 then 'Late In ('+Time_IN+')' else '' end as A_LStatus , isnull ( fintab2.TotalLeaves ,0)- isnull( fintab2.AllLeavesAvail , 0 ) as LeavesRemaining ,* from (
SELECT
(select sum ( leavedays ) from HRMS_EmployeePayroll where PersonID = fintab.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status =1) as TotalLeaves, (select sum ( Quantity ) from HRMS_EmployeeAttendance where PersonID = fintab.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Status =1 and monthyear between @FromDate and @ToDate ) as LeavesAvailforDate, (select sum ( Quantity ) from HRMS_EmployeeAttendance where PersonID = fintab.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Status =1 ) as AllLeavesAvail, fintab.TheDate,convert(varchar(2),TheDate,106)as NewDate, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, fintab.UserName,fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,EmployeeCode,FullName,DesignationName,DepartmentName,ShiftName,
--STimeIN,STimeOUT, ShiftTimeIN as STimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT as STimeOUT,
MIN(TMSTimeIN) as ETimeIN,MAX(TMSTimeOUT) as ETimeOUT,
--case -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < STimeIN then 'Early In' -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) = STimeIN then 'On Time' -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' -- else '--' --end --+ ' / ' + --case -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 'Early Out' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) = STimeOUT then 'On Time' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOUT then 'Late Out' -- else '--' --end as AttStatus,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 'Early In' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 'On Time' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' else '--' end + case when DataTypeIN='*' then '*' else '' end + ' / ' + case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 'Early Out' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeOUT then 'On Time' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then 'Late Out' else '--' end + case when DataTypeOUT='*' then '*' else '' end as AttStatus,
case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) else '----' end as Time_IN, case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) else '----' end as Time_OUT,
--case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID)>0 then 'L' --else -- case -- when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then 'W/O' -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' -- else -- 'A' -- end --end as Status,
case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then case when MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) is not null then MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) else 'L' end else case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Description = 'Sunday' and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null then 'W/O' when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G.H' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' else 'A' end end as [Status], CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(fintab.TimeInGrace),108) as TimeInGrace ,CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(fintab.TimeOutGrace),108) as TimeOutGrace ,fintab.ShiftID TerminalNo,
--count(LR.LeaveRequestID) as CountLeave, case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountLeave,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 1 when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 1 else 0 end as CountPresent, case when (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null) AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID)=0 then 1 else 0 end as CountAbsent,
--case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInEarly, --case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) = STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInOnTime, --case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInLate,
--case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutEarly, --case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) = STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutOnTime, --case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutLate
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInEarly, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInOnTime, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInLate,
case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutEarly, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutOnTime, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutLate
from (
SELECT SET_DateTime.Description,SET_DateTime.Reason , SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.CreatedByValue as UserName, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName, SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.[Description] as ShiftName,
case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) -- ,101) as STimeIN, --CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) --,101) as STimeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) as STimeOUT,
ETMS1.TerminalNo ,CONVERT(varchar(50),SS.TimeInGrace,108) as TimeInGrace , CONVERT(varchar(50),SS.TimeOutGrace,108) as TimeOutGrace ,SS.ShiftID from SET_DateTime
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID in (@CompanyID)) {1}
and EP.Status=1 and EP.IsActive = 1
left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ED ON ED.JobDesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS_Shift on ETMS_Shift.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS_Shift.PersonID = EP.PersonID and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate LEFT join HRMS_Set_Shift SS on ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime >= SS.FromDate AND ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime <= SS.ToDate {0} ) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on --PT.CompanyID=LR.CompanyID and PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1 and PT.IsActive = 1 {2} group by TheDate,fintab.UserName, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,EmployeeCode,FullName,DesignationName,DepartmentName, IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,ShiftName, DataTypeIN,DataTypeOUT, ShiftTimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT, fintab.TimeInGrace ,fintab.TimeOutGrace ,fintab.ShiftID ,STimeIN,STimeOUT,fintab.TerminalNo ,fintab.Description,fintab.Reason ) fintab2 {3} Order by fintab2.TheDate,fintab2.EmployeeCode

data.name: Query_TMS_Master
data.value:
SELECT fintab.TheDate,convert(varchar(2),TheDate,106)as NewDate, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, ( Case when fintab.DayDescription ='Monday' then 'Mon' when fintab.DayDescription ='Tuesday' then 'Tue' when fintab.DayDescription ='Wednesday' then 'Wed' when fintab.DayDescription ='Thursday' then 'Thu' When fintab.DayDescription ='Friday' then 'Fri' When fintab.DayDescription ='Saturday' then 'Sat' When fintab.DayDescription ='Sunday' then 'Sun' else '' end ) as ShortDay_Name, datename(month,fintab.TheDate) Month_Name, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,DepartmentName,ShiftName,ShiftCode,
ShiftTimeIN as STimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT as STimeOUT,
STimeIN,STimeOUT,MIN(TMSTimeIN) as ETimeIN,MAX(TMSTimeOUT) as ETimeOUT,SectionName,LocationName, fintab.JoiningDate,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 'Early In' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 'On Time' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' else '--' end + case when DataTypeIN='*' then '*' else '' end + ' / ' + case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 'Early Out' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeOUT then 'On Time' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then 'Late Out' else '--' end + case when DataTypeOUT='*' then '*' else '' end as AttStatus,
case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) else '----' end as Time_IN, case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) else '----' end as Time_OUT,
-- case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then --case when MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) is not null then MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) else 'L' end -- else -- case --when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Description = 'Sunday' and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null then 'W/O' --when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G.H' --when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' -- else -- 'A' -- end -- end as [Status],
--newStatus
case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then case when MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) is not null then MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) else 'L' end
when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G.H' --3 when (CASE WHEN max(TMSTimeOUT) is null and shiftName != 'OD' and min(STimeIN) is null then null else case when isnull(IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and shiftName = 'OD' then LAG(ShiftName) OVER(ORDER BY fintab.TheDate,fintab.PersonID) else ShiftName end end ) = 'OD' then 'OD'
else case
--4 -- when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) then 'A' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) = null or CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) = null then 'A' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'A'
----5 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108)< CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --else 'A' end when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ')) and (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ')) then 'A' when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) = null or CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) = null then 'A' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ')) then 'A'
--5 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') between stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') between stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) --and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, min(TMSTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) --and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108)< CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) -- and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
else 'A' end end as [Status],
--endNewStatus
CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN)),108)as CalculatedHours,IsOverTime, convert(varchar(5),Breaktime,108) Breaktime, --case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then --convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) --else '00:00' end as overtime, case when STimeOUT is null then ( case isnull(IsOverTime,0) when 0 then '00:00' else ( case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday' then CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN) - (case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(time,MAX(Breaktime),108) end ) ),108) when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) else '00:00' end ) end ) else ( case isnull(IsOverTime,0) when 0 then '00:00' else ( case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday' then
CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN) - (case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(time,MAX(Breaktime),108) end ) ),108) when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOUT then convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) else '00:00' end ) end ) end as OverTime, (DateDiff(s,MIN(TMSTimeIN),MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MIN(TMSTimeIN),MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 as TotWorkMinuts, case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then (DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 else 0 end as TotOverMinuts, --TerminalNo, TerminalNo1, TerminalNo2, case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountLeave,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 1 when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountPresent, case when (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null) AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID)=0 then 1 else 0 end as CountAbsent,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInEarly, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInOnTime, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInLate,
case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutEarly, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutOnTime, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutLate , case when MIN(TMSTIMEIN) > ShiftTImeIn then (DateDiff(s, ( case when STIMEIN is null then ShiftTimeIN else STIMEIN end ), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, ( case when STIMEIN is null then ShiftTimeIN else STIMEIN end ), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))%3600/60 else 0 end as TotlateMinuts
from (
SELECT SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay, SET_DateTime.Reason, ABC.ShiftCode, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.PersonTypeCode,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName,EP.IsOverTime as IsOverTime , SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription,ETMS1.TerminalNo as TerminalNo1,ETMS2.TerminalNo as TerminalNo2, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,ABC.[Description] as ShiftName, (case when ETMS1.TMSDateTime IS null and ETMS2.TMSDateTime is null then '00:00' else ABC.Breaktime end) as Breaktime, case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),ABC.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),ABC.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),ABC.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),ABC.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) as STimeOUT, ETMS1.TerminalNo
from SET_DateTime
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID in @CompanyID) {3} and EP.Status = 1 and EP.IsActive = 1 {1} and EP.Status=1 left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ED ON ED.JobDesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1

left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate {0} ) as fintab

data.name: Query_TMS_MasterSummary
data.value:
Select CompanyID,PersonID,EmployeeCode,IsOffDayGazt,FullName,DesignationName,DepartmentName,ShiftName, sum(CountLeave) as Days_Leave,sum(CountPresent) as Days_Present,sum(CountAbsent) as Days_Absent, sum(CountLeave) + sum(CountPresent) + sum(CountAbsent) as Days_Total, sum(CountInLate) as Days_Late,sum(CountOutEarly) as Days_Early from ( SELECT distinct fintab.TheDate,convert(varchar(2),TheDate,106)as NewDate, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,EmployeeCode,IsOffDayGazt,FullName,DesignationName,DepartmentName,ShiftName,
--case when max(LeavesCount)>0 then 'L' --else -- case -- when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then 'P' -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' -- else 'A' end --end --as Status,
case when count(LR.LeaverequestID) > 0 then case when MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) is not null then MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) else 'L' end else case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Description = 'Sunday' and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null then 'W/O' when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G.H' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' else 'A' end end as [Status],
max(LeavesCount) as CountLeave,
-- case -- when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 1 else -- case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 1 when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 1 else 0 end --end as CountPresent, -- case -- when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 0 else -- Case when (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null) AND max(fintab.LeavesCount)=0 -- then 1 else 0 end --end as CountAbsent,
case when isnull(IsOffDayGazt,0) = 1 then (case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Reason is null then 1 when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Reason is not null and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 1 when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Reason is not null and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null then 0 else case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 1 when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 1 else 0 end end) else (case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then 1 else case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 1 when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 1 else 0 end end) end as CountPresent,
case when isnull(IsOffDayGazt,0) = 1 then (case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Reason is null then 0 when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Reason is not null and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 0 when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Reason is not null and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null then 1 else Case when (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null) AND max(fintab.LeavesCount)=0 then 1 else 0 end end) else (case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then 0 else Case when (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null) AND max(fintab.LeavesCount)=0 then 1 else 0 end end) end as CountAbsent,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInLate, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutEarly
from (
SELECT SET_DateTime.Reason, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.IsOffDayGazt,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,ED.DesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName, SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.[Description] as ShiftName, (Select case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) >0 then 1 else 0 end from HRMS_LeaveRequest LR where LR.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = EP.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1) as LeavesCount,
case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) -- ,101) as STimeIN, --CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) --,101) as STimeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) as STimeOUT,
ETMS1.TerminalNo
from SET_DateTime
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null)
and EP.Status=1 and EP.IsActive = 1 left JOIN SET_Designation ED ON ED.DesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
--left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1 left join HRMS_AttendanceRoaster ES on ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status = 1 left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1
left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate where SET_DateTime.TheDate >= @FromDate and SET_DateTime.TheDate <= @ToDate {0}
) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on -- PT.CompanyID=LR.CompanyID and PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1
left join Set_Section on Set_Section.SectionID = fintab.FK_SectionID and Set_Section.Status =1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = fintab.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1
group by TheDate, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,EmployeeCode,IsOffDayGazt,FullName,DesignationName,DepartmentName, IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,ShiftName, STimeIN,STimeOUT,fintab.TerminalNo,fintab.JoiningDate,fintab.Description ,fintab.Reason
) TAB where ShiftName != 'OD' Group by CompanyID,PersonID,EmployeeCode,IsOffDayGazt,FullName,DesignationName,DepartmentName,ShiftName Order by EmployeeCode
