else 'A' end) = 'P' and (case when stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (STimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') then 'L' else '' end) = 'L'
then (convert(varchar(2), DateDiff(Minute, stuff(convert(varchar(19), (STimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') , stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ')) / 60) + ':' + right('0' + convert(varchar(2), DateDiff(Minute, stuff(convert(varchar(19), (STimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') , stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ')) % 60), 2)) else '0:00' end ) as LateHours, --endNewLateHrsWorking
case WHEN count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then 0 when fintab.Reason !='' OR MAX(HRMS_SET_OffDays.OffDayDate) is not null then 0 when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutLate ,
case when fintab.Reason !='' OR MAX(HRMS_SET_OffDays.OffDayDate) is not null then '0' when MAX(TMSTimeOut) < ShiftTimeOut then Case when ((DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)%3600/60 )<=15 and count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 60 when ((DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)%3600/60 ) > 15 and ((DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)%3600/60 ) <= 240 and count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 240 when ((DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)%3600/60 ) > 240 then 0 else 0 end else 0 end as EarlyOutMins,
case when fintab.Reason !='' OR MAX(HRMS_SET_OffDays.OffDayDate) is not null then '00:00' --when MAX(TMSTimeOut) < ShiftTimeOut then -- --Convert(Varchar(10),abs((DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60/60)) +':'+ Convert(Varchar(20),abs(DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 )) -- convert(varchar(2),replicate('0', 2 - len(abs((DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60/60)) + cast(abs((DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60/60) as varchar)) ) -- + ':' + -- convert(varchar(2),replicate('0', 2 - len(abs(DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 )) + cast(abs(DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, Max(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 ) as varchar)) )
when MAX(TMSTimeOut) < ShiftTimeOut then Case when ((DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)%3600/60 )<=15 and count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then '01:00' when ((DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)%3600/60 ) > 15 and ((DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)%3600/60 ) <= 240 and count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then '04:00' when ((DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MAX(TMSTimeOUT),ShiftTimeOUT)%3600/60 ) > 240 then '00:00' else '00:00' end else '00:00' end as EarlyOutHours
,case when fintab.Reason !='' OR MAX(HRMS_SET_OffDays.OffDayDate) is not null then 0 when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 AND Count(LR.ShortLeaveType) >0 and ( ( select top 1 HalfDayCategory from HRMS_LeaveRequest LR2 left join HRMS_ShortLeaveType SR2 on SR2.ShortLeaveTypeID = LR2.ShortLeaveType left join HRMS_PayrollType PT2 on -- PT2.CompanyID=LR2.CompanyID and PT2.PayrollTypeID=LR2.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT2.PayrollTypeCode=LR2.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT2.[Status]=1 where LR2.HalfDayCategory = 1 and LR2.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR2.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and CONVERT(date,LR2.FromDate) <= fintab.TheDate and CONVERT(date,LR2.ToDate) >= fintab.TheDate and LR2.[Status]=1 and LR2.[IsApproved]=1 ) = 1
and
( select top 1 HalfDayCategory from HRMS_LeaveRequest LR2 left join HRMS_ShortLeaveType SR2 on SR2.ShortLeaveTypeID = LR2.ShortLeaveType left join HRMS_PayrollType PT2 on --PT2.CompanyID=LR2.CompanyID and PT2.PayrollTypeID=LR2.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT2.PayrollTypeCode=LR2.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT2.[Status]=1 where LR2.HalfDayCategory = 2 and LR2.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR2.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and CONVERT(date,LR2.FromDate) <= fintab.TheDate and CONVERT(date,LR2.ToDate) >= fintab.TheDate and LR2.[Status]=1 and LR2.[IsApproved]=1 ) = 2
) then 2
when fintab.Reason !='' OR MAX(HRMS_SET_OffDays.OffDayDate) is not null then 0 when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 AND Count(LR.ShortLeaveType) >0 then 1 else 0 end CountHalfDays ,fintab.Reason ,fintab.MAReason ,HRMS_SET_OffDays.OffDayDate from -- () #tempTable as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID -- and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1 and CONVERT(date,LR.FromDate) <= fintab.TheDate and CONVERT(date,LR.ToDate) >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1 left join HRMS_ShortLeaveType SR on SR.ShortLeaveTypeID = LR.ShortLeaveType left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on -- PT.CompanyID=LR.CompanyID and PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1
left join Set_Section on Set_Section.SectionID = fintab.FK_SectionID and Set_Section.Status =1 left JOIN HRMS_SET_OffDays ON HRMS_SET_OffDays.PersonID=fintab.PersonID and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, fintab.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, fintab.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, fintab.TheDate)) ,101) = HRMS_SET_OffDays.OffDayDate
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = fintab.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1
-- where ((fintab.TerminalNo2 = 0 or fintab.TerminalNo2 is null) and ShiftCode is null or ShiftCode = '' ) Or (fintab.TerminalNo2 > 0 --and (ShiftCode is not null )) group by TheDate, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,IsOverTime,DepartmentName, IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,ShiftName,DataTypeIN,DataTypeOUT,ShiftTimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT,TerminalNo1,ShiftCode, TerminalNo2,STimeIN,STimeOUT,SectionName,LocationName,fintab.JoiningDate,fintab.Reason,fintab.Description,Breaktime,IsExtraOverTime ,fintab.MAReason, isManualOut ,isManualin,fintab.BasicSalary ,fintab.IsNormalDay,HRMS_SET_OffDays.OffDayDate ,fintab.IsLateFine,fintab.IsAttendanceWaver,fintab.HoursPerDay,fintab.HoursPerMonth,fintab.TolPerMonth Order by PersonID,TheDate,EmployeeCode,Month_Name

data.name: Query_YearlyAttendance
data.value:
select sum(tab.CountInLate) as Amount,'Late' as Category, Month_Name, EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName, CASE Month_Name WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3 WHEN 'April' THEN 4 WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6 WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8 WHEN 'September' THEN 9 WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 WHEN 'December' THEN 12 END as MonthOrder
from ( SELECT datename(month,fintab.TheDate) as Month_Name, EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,
count(LR.LeaveRequestID) as CountLeave, case when (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null) AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID)=0 then 1 else 0 end as CountAbsent, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInLate
from ( SELECT EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,ED.DesignationName AS DesignationName, DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName, SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.[Description] as ShiftName,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as STimeOUT,
ETMS1.TerminalNo from SET_DateTime inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID in (@CompanyID)) and EP.Status = 1 and EP.IsActive = 1 {1} {3} and EP.Status=1 left JOIN SET_Designation ED ON ED.DesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1 left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1 and SS.IsActive = 1
left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate {0}
) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on --PT.CompanyID=LR.CompanyID and PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1 and PT.IsActive = 1
left join Set_Section on Set_Section.SectionID = fintab.FK_SectionID and Set_Section.Status =1 and SET_Section.IsActive = 1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = fintab.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 and SET_Location.IsActive = 1 {2}
group by FullName,TheDate,EmployeeCode,FatherName,STimeIN,STimeOUT
) tab group by Month_Name,FullName,EmployeeCode,FatherName
union all
select sum(tab.CountAbsent)as Amount,'Abst' as Category, Month_Name, EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName, CASE Month_Name WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3 WHEN 'April' THEN 4 WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6 WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8 WHEN 'September' THEN 9 WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 WHEN 'December' THEN 12 END as MonthOrder
from (
SELECT datename(month,fintab.TheDate) as Month_Name, EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,
count(LR.LeaveRequestID) as CountLeave, case when (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null) AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID)=0 then 1 else 0 end as CountAbsent, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInLate
from ( SELECT EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,ED.DesignationName AS DesignationName, DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName, SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.[Description] as ShiftName,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as STimeOUT,
ETMS1.TerminalNo from SET_DateTime inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID in (@CompanyID)) {1} {3} and EP.Status=1 left JOIN SET_Designation ED ON ED.DesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1 left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1 and SS.IsActive = 1
left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate {0}
) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on --PT.CompanyID=LR.CompanyID and PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1 and PT.IsActive = 1
left join Set_Section on Set_Section.SectionID = fintab.FK_SectionID and Set_Section.Status =1 and Set_Section.IsActive = 1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = fintab.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 and SET_Location.IsActive = 1 {2}
group by FullName,TheDate,EmployeeCode,FatherName,STimeIN,STimeOUT
) tab group by Month_Name,FullName,EmployeeCode,FatherName order by MonthOrder

data.name: Query_GetTimeSheetStatus_INN
data.value:
SELECT distinct fintab.TheDate,fintab.EmployeeCode, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.FullName,fintab.DepartmentName,fintab.DesignationName,fintab.ShiftName,
--STimeIN,STimeOUT, ShiftTimeIN as STimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT as STimeOUT,
MIN(TMSTimeIN) as ETimeIN,MAX(TMSTimeOUT) as ETimeOUT,
--case -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < STimeIN then 'Early In' -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) = STimeIN then 'On Time' -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' -- else '--' --end --+ ' / ' + --case -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 'Early Out' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) = STimeOUT then 'On Time' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOUT then 'Late Out' -- else '--' --end as AttStatus,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 'Early In' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 'On Time' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' else '--' end + case when DataTypeIN='*' then '*' else '' end + ' / ' + case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 'Early Out' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeOUT then 'On Time' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then 'Late Out' else '--' end + case when DataTypeOUT='*' then '*' else '' end as AttStatus,
case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) else '----' end as Time_IN, case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) else '----' end as Time_OUT,
--case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID)>0 then 'L' --else -- case -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' -- else -- 'A' -- end --end as Status
case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then case when MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) is not null then MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) else 'L' end else case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Description = 'Sunday' and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null then 'W/O' when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G.H' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' else 'A' end end as [Status]
from (
SELECT SET_DateTime.TheDate,EmployeeCode, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.FullName,ED.DesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName, SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.[Description] as ShiftName,
case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) -- ,101) as STimeIN, --CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) --,101) as STimeOUT
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) as STimeOUT
from SET_DateTime
INNER JOIN HRMS_Set_Employee EP on ( EP.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID is null) and (EP.CompanyID = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) and EP.Status = 1 and EP.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Designation ED ON ED.DesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
INNER JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1 INNER JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1
INNER JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min INNER JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
where SET_DateTime.TheDate between @FromDate and @ToDate {0} ) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on PT.CompanyID=LR.CompanyID and PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1
group by fintab.TheDate,fintab.EmployeeCode ,fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.FullName,fintab.DesignationName,fintab.DepartmentName, fintab.IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,fintab.ShiftName, DataTypeIN,DataTypeOUT, ShiftTimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT, fintab.STimeIN,fintab.STimeOUT
Order by fintab.PersonID,fintab.TheDate

data.name: Query_GetTMSActiveDateWithLeaves_INN
data.value:
SELECT distinct fintab.TheDate, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,EmployeeCode,FullName,DesignationName,DepartmentName,ShiftName,
--STimeIN,STimeOUT, ShiftTimeIN as STimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT as STimeOUT,
MIN(TMSTimeIN) as ETimeIN,MAX(TMSTimeOUT) as ETimeOUT,
--case -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < STimeIN then 'Early In' -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) = STimeIN then 'On Time' -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' -- else '--' --end --+ ' / ' + --case -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 'Early Out' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) = STimeOUT then 'On Time' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOUT then 'Late Out' -- else '--' --end as AttStatus,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 'Early In' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 'On Time' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' else '--' end + case when DataTypeIN='*' then '*' else '' end + ' / ' + case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 'Early Out' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeOUT then 'On Time' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then 'Late Out' else '--' end + case when DataTypeOUT='*' then '*' else '' end as AttStatus, case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) else '----' end as Time_IN, case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) else '----' end as Time_OUT,
--case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID)>0 then 'L' --else -- case -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' -- else -- 'A' -- end --end as Status
case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then case when MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) is not null then MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) else 'L' end else case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.[DayDescription] = 'Sunday' and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null then 'W/O' when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G.H' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' else 'A' end end as [Status]
from (
SELECT SET_DateTime.TheDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName, SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription,SET_DateTime.Reason, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.[Description] as ShiftName,
case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) -- ,101) as STimeIN, --CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) --,101) as STimeOUT
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) as STimeOUT
from SET_DateTime
INNER JOIN HRMS_Set_Employee EP on ( EP.PersonID = @PersonID OR @PersonID is null) and (EP.CompanyID in @CompanyID) and EP.Status = 1 and EP.IsActive = 1 --left JOIN SET_Designation ED ON ED.DesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ED ON ED.JobDesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
--left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID=1 and SS.Status=1 --left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ES.ShiftID=SS.ShiftID and ES.PersonID=12 and ES.Status=1
left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1 left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1
left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
where SET_DateTime.TheDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND ( EP.PersonTypeCode = @PersonType OR @PersonType is null) and SET_DateTime.TheDate >= EP.JoiningDate and SET_DateTime.TheDate <= isnull(EP.jobEndingDate,getdate()) ) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on -- PT.CompanyID=LR.CompanyID and PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1 and PT.IsActive = 1
group by TheDate, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,EmployeeCode,FullName,DesignationName,DepartmentName, IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,Reason,ShiftName, DataTypeIN,DataTypeOUT, ShiftTimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT, STimeIN,STimeOUT
Order by DepartmentName asc

data.name: Query_TMS_MasterTwo
data.value:
SELECT fintab.TheDate,convert(varchar(2),TheDate,106)as NewDate, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, datename(month,fintab.TheDate)Month_Name, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID, isnull(fintab.ShiftID,XYZ) as ShiftID ,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode ,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,DepartmentName, fintab.sh as ShiftName,
ShiftTimeIN as STimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT as STimeOUT,
STimeIN,STimeOUT,MIN(TMSTimeIN) as ETimeIN,MAX(TMSTimeOUT) as ETimeOUT,SectionName,LocationName, fintab.JoiningDate,
case when STimeOUT is null then ( case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 'Early In' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 'On Time' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' else '--' end + case when DataTypeIN='*' then '*' else '' end + ' / ' + case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < ShiftTimeOUT then 'Early Out' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeOUT then 'On Time' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then 'Late Out' else '--' end + case when DataTypeOUT='*' then '*' else '' end )
else ( case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 'Early In' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 'On Time' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' else '--' end + case when DataTypeIN='*' then '*' else '' end + ' / ' + case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= ShiftTimeOut and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= STimeOut
then 'On Time'
when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOut then 'Early Out'
when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOut then 'Late Out' else '--' end + case when DataTypeOUT='*' then '*' else '' end )end as AttStatus,
case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) else '----' end as Time_IN, case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) else '----' end as Time_OUT, case when Breaktime='00:00' then '----' when CONVERT(varchar(5),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(5),MAX(Breaktime),108) else '----' end as BreakTime,
case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then case when MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) is not null then MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) else 'L' end else case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Description = 'Sunday' and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null then 'W/O' when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G/H' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' else 'A' end end as [Status],
CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN) - (case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(time,MAX(Breaktime),108) end ) ),108)
as CalculatedHours
,IsOverTime,
case when STimeOUT is null then (
case isnull(IsOverTime,0) when 0 then '00:00' else ( case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday' then
CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN) - (case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(time,MAX(Breaktime),108) end ) ),108)
when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60)
else '00:00' end )
end
) else (
case isnull(IsOverTime,0) when 0 then '00:00' else ( case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday' then
CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN) - (case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(time,MAX(Breaktime),108) end ) ),108)
when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOUT then convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60)
else '00:00' end )
end
) end as overtime,
DateDiff(n, MIN(TMSTimeIN), MIN(TMSTimeOUT)) - ((DatePart(Hour, Max(BreakTime)) * 60) + DatePart(Minute, Max(BreakTime)))
as TotWorkMinuts,
case when STimeOUT is null then ((
case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday'
then DateDiff(n, MIN(TMSTimeIN), MIN(TMSTimeOUT)) - ((DatePart(Hour, Max(BreakTime)) * 60) + DatePart(Minute, Max(BreakTime)))
when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then (DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60
else 0 end ))else ((
case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday'
then DateDiff(n, MIN(TMSTimeIN), MIN(TMSTimeOUT)) - ((DatePart(Hour, Max(BreakTime)) * 60) + DatePart(Minute, Max(BreakTime)))
when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOUT then (DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60
else 0 end )) end as TotOverMinuts,
TerminalNo, case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountLeave,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 1 when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountPresent, case when (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null) AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID)=0 then 1 else 0 end as CountAbsent,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInEarly, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInOnTime, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInLate,
case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutEarly, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutOnTime, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutLate from (
SELECT SET_DateTime.Reason, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,SS.ShiftID,ABC.ShiftID AS XYZ,ABC.Description AS sh, (case -- when SET_DateTime.IsHoliday=1 or SET_DateTime.Description='Sunday' then '00:00' when ETMS1.TMSDateTime IS null and ETMS2.TMSDateTime is null then '00:00' else ABC.Breaktime end) as Breaktime ,EP.PersonID,EP.PersonTypeCode,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName,EP.IsOverTime as IsOverTime , SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.Description as ShiftName,
case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) as STimeOUT, ETMS1.TerminalNo
from SET_DateTime
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) {1} {4} and
EP.Status=1 left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ED ON ED.JobDesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1
AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1 {1}
left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1
--left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1
left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS_Shift on ETMS_Shift.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS_Shift.PersonID = EP.PersonID and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
LEFT join HRMS_Set_Shift SS on ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime >= SS.FromDate AND ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime <= SS.ToDate LEFT join HRMS_Set_Shift ABC on SET_DateTime.THEDATE >= ABC.FromDate and SET_DateTime.THEDATE <= ABC.ToDate and ABC.Status=1
{0} {3}
) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on PT.CompanyID=LR.CompanyID and PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1
left join Set_Section on Set_Section.SectionID = fintab.FK_SectionID and Set_Section.Status =1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = fintab.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 {2}
group by TheDate, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.ShiftID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,IsOverTime,DepartmentName, IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,ShiftName,DataTypeIN,DataTypeOUT,ShiftTimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT, STimeIN,STimeOUT,fintab.TerminalNo,SectionName,LocationName,fintab.JoiningDate,fintab.Reason,fintab.Description,fintab.Breaktime ,XYZ,sh Order by TheDate,EmployeeCode,Month_Name

data.name: Query_TMS_MasterSummaryForAsadRice
data.value:
--Declare @periodID int --set @periodID=1
--Declare @companyID int --set @companyID=1
--Declare @FromDate datetime --set @FromDate ='2018-11-01 00:00:00.000'
--Declare @ToDate datetime --set @ToDate='2018-11-30 00:00:00.000'
--drop table #tempTable
SELECT distinct SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,isNull(SET_DateTime.Reason,'') [Reason]
--, SS.ShiftCode ,(case when (SET_DateTime.Description = 'Sunday' and isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID > 0) then (SELECT HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftCode FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' then LAG(SS.ShiftCode) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID) else SS.ShiftCode end) as ShiftCode , isnull(SS.HoursPerDay,0) as HoursPerDay , isnull(SS.HoursPerMonth,0) as HoursPerMonth , isnull(SS.TolPerMonth,0) as TolPerMonth
, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.PersonTypeCode,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,EP.BasicSalary,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName,EP.IsOverTime as IsOverTime ,EP.BasicSalary as Salary , SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription,ETMS1.TerminalNo as TerminalNo1,ETMS.TerminalNo as TerminalNo2, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS.Time_OUT as TMSTimeOUT --,SS.[Description] as ShiftName ,(case when SET_DateTime.[Description] = 'Sunday' and isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID != 0 then (SELECT top 1 HRMS_Set_Shift.[Description] FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when (isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' ) then LAG(SS.Description) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID) else SS.[Description] end) as ShiftName
,EP.IsExtraOverTime, --(case when ETMS1.TMSDateTime IS null and ETMS.Time_OUT is null then '00:00' else ABC.Breaktime end) as Breaktime, '00:00' as Breaktime, case when ETMS.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS.RawData='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT, ISNULL(ETMS1.reason,ETMS.Reason) as MAReason, case when ETMS1.RawData='M' then '*' else '' end isManualin ,case when ETMS.RawData='M' then '*' else '' end isManualOut,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) -- ,101) as ShiftTimeIN,
(case when SET_DateTime.Description = 'Sunday' and SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID > 0 then (SELECT top 1 CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),HRMS_Set_Shift.TimeIn,114) ,101) FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when (isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' ) then
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ',101) +LAG( CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114)

when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ')) and (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ')) then 0 when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) = null or CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) = null then 0 when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ')) then 0
--5 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') between stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 1
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') between stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 1
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) --and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, min(TMSTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 1
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) --and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108)< CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 1
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) -- and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 1
else 0 end )
as CountPresent,
-- case -- when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then 0 else -- Case when (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null) AND max(fintab.LeavesCount)=0 -- then 1 else 0 end --end
( case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then 0
when fintab.Reason != '' then 0 --3 when (CASE WHEN max(TMSTimeOUT) is null and shiftName != 'OD' and min(STimeIN) is null then null else case when isnull(isNormalDay,0) = 1 and shiftName = 'OD' then LAG(ShiftName) OVER(ORDER BY fintab.TheDate,fintab.PersonID) else ShiftName end end ) = 'OD' then 0
--4 -- when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) then 1 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) = null or CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) = null then 1 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 1
----5 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 0 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 0 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 0 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108)< CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 0 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 0 --else 1 end -- ) when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ')) and (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ')) then 1 when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) = null or CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) = null then 1 when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ')) then 1
--5 when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') between stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 0 when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') between stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 0 when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, min(TMSTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 0 when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 0 when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 0
else 1 end )
as CountAbsent,
--case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end ( case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then 0
when fintab.Reason != '' then 0 --3 when (CASE WHEN max(TMSTimeOUT) is null and shiftName != 'OD' and min(STimeIN) is null then null else case when isnull(isNormalDay,0) = 1 and shiftName = 'OD' then LAG(ShiftName) OVER(ORDER BY fintab.TheDate,fintab.PersonID) else ShiftName end end ) = 'OD' then 0 --1 when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),STimeIN,108) then 1 when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),STimeIN,108) then 0 when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) then 0
else 0 end) as CountInLate, -- case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end
( case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then 0
when fintab.Reason != '' then 0 when (CASE WHEN max(TMSTimeOUT) is null and shiftName != 'OD' and min(STimeIN) is null then null else case when isnull(isNormalDay,0) = 1 and shiftName = 'OD' then LAG(ShiftName) OVER(ORDER BY fintab.TheDate,fintab.PersonID) else ShiftName end end ) = 'OD' then 0 when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 1 when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),STimeOUT,108) then 0 when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),STimeOUT,108) then 0 else 0 end) as CountOutEarly
from (
SELECT SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay, SET_DateTime.Reason, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,ED.DesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName, SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.[Description] as ShiftName, (Select case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) >0 then 1 else 0 end from HRMS_LeaveRequest LR where LR.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = EP.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1) as LeavesCount,
case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) -- ,101) as STimeIN, --CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) --,101) as STimeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) as STimeOUT,
ETMS1.TerminalNo
from SET_DateTime
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null)
and EP.Status=1 and EP.IsActive = 1 left JOIN SET_Designation ED ON ED.DesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
--left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1 --left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1
--left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min --left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_AttendanceRoaster ES on ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status = 1 --and ES.ShiftFrom <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ShiftTo >= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND CONVERT(date,ES.ShiftFrom)=Convert(date,SET_DateTime.TheDate) left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1
left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate --where SET_DateTime.TheDate >= @FromDate and SET_DateTime.TheDate <= @ToDate where SET_DateTime.TheDate >= @FromDate and SET_DateTime.TheDate <= @ToDate and EP.IsActive = 1 -- and SET_DateTime.TheDate >= EP.JoiningDate and ( (EP.JobEndingDate is not null and SET_DateTime.TheDate between EP.JoiningDate and EP.JobEndingDate) OR (EP.JobEndingDate is null and SET_DateTime.TheDate >= EP.JoiningDate) ) ) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on -- PT.CompanyID=LR.CompanyID and PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1
left join Set_Section on Set_Section.SectionID = fintab.FK_SectionID and Set_Section.Status =1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = fintab.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1
group by TheDate, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,EmployeeCode,FullName,DesignationName,DepartmentName, IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,ShiftName, STimeIN,STimeOUT,fintab.TerminalNo,fintab.JoiningDate,fintab.Description ,fintab.Reason ,fintab.IsNormalDay,fintab.ShiftTimeIN,fintab.ShiftTimeOUT
order by PersonID,TheDate,EmployeeCode
--) TAB

data.name: Query_TMS_Attendence_two
data.value:
--Declare @periodID int --set @periodID=1
--Declare @companyID int --set @companyID=1
--Declare @FromDate datetime --set @FromDate ='2018-11-01 00:00:00.000'
--Declare @ToDate datetime --set @ToDate='2018-11-30 00:00:00.000'
--drop table #tempTable
SELECT distinct SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,isNull(SET_DateTime.Reason,'') [Reason] , SS.HoursPerDay
--, SS.ShiftCode ,(case when (SET_DateTime.Description = 'Sunday' and isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID > 0) then (SELECT HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftCode FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' then LAG(SS.ShiftCode) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID) else SS.ShiftCode end) as ShiftCode
, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.PersonTypeCode,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,EP.BasicSalary,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName,EP.IsOverTime as IsOverTime , SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription,ETMS1.TerminalNo as TerminalNo1,ETMS.TerminalNo as TerminalNo2, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS.Time_OUT as TMSTimeOUT --,SS.[Description] as ShiftName ,(case when SET_DateTime.[Description] = 'Sunday' and isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID != 0 then (SELECT top 1 HRMS_Set_Shift.[Description] FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when (isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' ) then LAG(SS.Description) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID) else SS.[Description] end) as ShiftName , ss.TimeIn ,ss.TimeOut
,EP.IsExtraOverTime, --(case when ETMS1.TMSDateTime IS null and ETMS.Time_OUT is null then '00:00' else ABC.Breaktime end) as Breaktime, '00:00' as Breaktime, case when ETMS.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS.RawData='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT, ISNULL(ETMS1.reason,ETMS.Reason) as MAReason, case when ETMS1.RawData='M' then '*' else '' end isManualin ,case when ETMS.RawData='M' then '*' else '' end isManualOut,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) -- ,101) as ShiftTimeIN,
(case when SET_DateTime.Description = 'Sunday' and SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID > 0 then (SELECT top 1 CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),HRMS_Set_Shift.TimeIn,114) ,101) FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when (isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' ) then
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ',101) +LAG( CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114)
) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID) else CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) end) as ShiftTimeIN,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year,ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) --,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
(case when SET_DateTime.Description = 'Sunday' and SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay = 1 and ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID > 0 then (SELECT top 1 CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year,ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),HRMS_Set_Shift.TimeOut,114) ,101) FROM HRMS_Set_Shift WHERE [Status] = 1 AND [IsActive] = 1 and HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID ) when (isnull(SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and SS.Description = 'OD' ) then CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year,ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ',101) +LAG( CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114)
) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID)
when ( SS.Description <> 'OD' and SS.Description = 'D' and convert(date,ETMS.Time_In) <> CONVERT(date,ETMS.Time_OUT) and SET_DateTime.Description = 'Saturday' and SS.Description <> 'Sunday' ) then CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS.Time_OUT)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2),DATEPART(dd, ETMS.Time_OUT) - 1) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year,ETMS.Time_OUT)) + ' ',101) +LAG( CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114)
) OVER(ORDER BY SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.PersonID)
