case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInEarly, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInOnTime, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInLate,
case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutEarly, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutOnTime, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutLate , ISNULL(SLT.Count,0) as Shortleave from (
SELECT SET_DateTime.Reason, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,SS.ShiftID,ABC.ShiftID AS XYZ,ABC.Description AS sh, (case -- when SET_DateTime.IsHoliday=1 or SET_DateTime.Description='Sunday' then '00:00' when ETMS1.TMSDateTime IS null and ETMS2.TMSDateTime is null then '00:00' else ABC.Breaktime end) as Breaktime ,EP.PersonID,EP.PersonTypeCode,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName,EP.IsOverTime as IsOverTime , SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.Description as ShiftName, ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID,
case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) as STimeOUT, ETMS1.TerminalNo --,ETMS1.IsOutDoorDuty ,'' as IsOutDoorDuty from SET_DateTime
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null)
{5} and
EP.Status=1 left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ED ON ED.JobDesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1
AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1
--left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1
left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS_Shift on ETMS_Shift.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS_Shift.PersonID = EP.PersonID and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_Set_Shift SS on ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime >= SS.FromDate AND ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime <= SS.ToDate
and ss.ShiftID = ETMS_Shift.ShiftHeaderID and ss.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID
left join HRMS_Set_Shift ABC on ABC.ShiftID = ETMS_Shift.ShiftHeaderID and ABC.ShiftID = ETMS1.ShiftHeaderID and ABC.Status=1
--LEFT join HRMS_Set_Shift SS on ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime >= SS.FromDate --AND ETMS_Shift.TMSDateTime <= SS.ToDate
--LEFT join HRMS_Set_Shift ABC on SET_DateTime.THEDATE >= ABC.FromDate --and SET_DateTime.THEDATE <= ABC.ToDate --and ABC.Status=1
--where SET_DateTime.TheDate >= @FromDate and SET_DateTime.TheDate <= @ToDate and EP.IsActive = 1 and SET_DateTime.TheDate >= EP.JoiningDate -- and SET_DateTime.TheDate <= isnull(EP.jobEndingDate,@ToDate)
{0} {1} ) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and Convert(date,LR.FromDate) <= fintab.TheDate and Convert(date,LR.ToDate) >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
LEFT join HRMS_ShortLeaveType SLT on SLT.ShortLeaveTypeID = LR.ShortLeaveType
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on --PT.CompanyID=LR.CompanyID and PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1
left join Set_Section on Set_Section.SectionID = fintab.FK_SectionID and Set_Section.Status =1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = fintab.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1
{7} group by TheDate, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.ShiftID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,IsOverTime,DepartmentName, IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,ShiftName,DataTypeIN,DataTypeOUT,ShiftTimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT, STimeIN,STimeOUT,fintab.TerminalNo,SectionName,LocationName,fintab.JoiningDate,fintab.Reason,fintab.Description,fintab.Breaktime ,XYZ,sh,SLT.Count,IsOutDoorDuty,ShiftHeaderID Order by TheDate,EmployeeCode,Month_Name
------------------------------------------------------------------
Select PayrolltypeCode,PayrollTypeID,Description,Abbreviation from HRMS_PayrollType where PayrolltypeCode = 4 and Status = 1 and IsActive =1 --and CompanyID = @CompanyID {6}

data.name: Query_TMS_Master_Summary
data.value:
SELECT fintab.TheDate,convert(varchar(2),TheDate,106)as NewDate, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, ( Case when fintab.DayDescription ='Monday' then 'Mon' when fintab.DayDescription ='Tuesday' then 'Tue' when fintab.DayDescription ='Wednesday' then 'Wed' when fintab.DayDescription ='Thursday' then 'Thu' When fintab.DayDescription ='Friday' then 'Fri' When fintab.DayDescription ='Saturday' then 'Sat' When fintab.DayDescription ='Sunday' then 'Sun' else '' end ) as ShortDay_Name, datename(month,fintab.TheDate) Month_Name, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,DepartmentName,ShiftName,ShiftCode,
ShiftTimeIN as STimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT as STimeOUT,
STimeIN,STimeOUT,MIN(TMSTimeIN) as ETimeIN,MAX(TMSTimeOUT) as ETimeOUT,SectionName,LocationName, fintab.JoiningDate,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 'Early In' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 'On Time' when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 'Late In' else '--' end + case when DataTypeIN='*' then '*' else '' end + ' / ' + case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 'Early Out' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeOUT then 'On Time' when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then 'Late Out' else '--' end + case when DataTypeOUT='*' then '*' else '' end as AttStatus,
case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MIN(TMSTimeIN),108) else '----' end as Time_IN, case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) is not null then CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(TMSTimeOUT),108) else '----' end as Time_OUT,
-- case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then --case when MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) is not null then MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) else 'L' end -- else -- case --when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Description = 'Sunday' and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null then 'W/O' --when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G.H' --when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' -- else -- 'A' -- end -- end as [Status],
--newStatus
case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then case when MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) is not null then MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) else 'L' end
when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G.H' --3 when (CASE WHEN max(TMSTimeOUT) is null and shiftName != 'OD' and min(STimeIN) is null then null else case when isnull(IsNormalDay,0) = 1 and shiftName = 'OD' then LAG(ShiftName) OVER(ORDER BY fintab.TheDate,fintab.PersonID) else ShiftName end end ) = 'OD' then 'OD'
else case
--4 -- when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) then 'A' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) = null or CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) = null then 'A' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'A'
----5 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108)< CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' --else 'A' end when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ')) and (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ')) then 'A' when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) = null or CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) = null then 'A' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ')) then 'A'
--5 --when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') between stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) between CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') between stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) --and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, min(TMSTimeIN)), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) --and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108)< CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), max(TMSTimeOUT), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
--when CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),min(TMSTimeIN),108) < CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeIN,108) -- and CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),max(TMSTimeOUT),108) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ShiftTimeOUT,108) then 'P' when (stuff(convert(varchar(19), min(TMSTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') < stuff(convert(varchar(19), (ShiftTimeIN), 126),11,1,' ') and stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, max(TMSTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') > stuff(convert(varchar(19),DATEADD(DAY, 0, (ShiftTimeOUT)), 126),11,1,' ') ) then 'P'
else 'A' end end as [Status],
--endNewStatus
CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN)),108)as CalculatedHours,IsOverTime, convert(varchar(5),Breaktime,108) Breaktime, --case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then --convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) --else '00:00' end as overtime, case when STimeOUT is null then ( case isnull(IsOverTime,0) when 0 then '00:00' else ( case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday' then CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN) - (case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(time,MAX(Breaktime),108) end ) ),108) when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) else '00:00' end ) end ) else ( case isnull(IsOverTime,0) when 0 then '00:00' else ( case when fintab.Reason != '' or fintab.Description = 'Sunday' then
CONVERT(varchar(20),(MIN(TMSTimeOUT)-MIN(TMSTimeIN) - (case when CONVERT(varchar(20),MAX(Breaktime),108) is not null then CONVERT(time,MAX(Breaktime),108) end ) ),108) when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > STimeOUT then convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)+':'+convert(varchar(5),DateDiff(s, STimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60) else '00:00' end ) end ) end as OverTime, (DateDiff(s,MIN(TMSTimeIN),MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, MIN(TMSTimeIN),MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 as TotWorkMinuts, case when MIN(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeOUT then (DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, ShiftTimeOUT, MIN(TMSTimeOUT))%3600/60 else 0 end as TotOverMinuts, --TerminalNo, TerminalNo1, TerminalNo2, case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountLeave,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 1 when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID) = 0 then 1 else 0 end as CountPresent, case when (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null) AND count(LR.LeaveRequestID)=0 then 1 else 0 end as CountAbsent,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) < ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInEarly, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) >= ShiftTimeIN AND MIN(TMSTimeIN) <= STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInOnTime, case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInLate,
case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutEarly, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) >= STimeOUT AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) <= ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutOnTime, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) > ShiftTimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountOutLate , case when MIN(TMSTIMEIN) > ShiftTImeIn then (DateDiff(s, ( case when STIMEIN is null then ShiftTimeIN else STIMEIN end ), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))/3600)*60 + DateDiff(s, ( case when STIMEIN is null then ShiftTimeIN else STIMEIN end ), MIN(TMSTIMEIN))%3600/60 else 0 end as TotlateMinuts
from (
SELECT SET_DateTime.IsNormalDay, SET_DateTime.Reason, SS.ShiftCode, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.PersonTypeCode,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,ED.JobDesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName,EP.IsOverTime as IsOverTime , SET_DateTime.IsHoliday,SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription,ETMS1.TerminalNo as TerminalNo1,ETMS2.TerminalNo as TerminalNo2, ETMS1.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeIN,ETMS2.TMSDateTime as TMSTimeOUT,SS.[Description] as ShiftName, (case when ETMS1.TMSDateTime IS null and ETMS2.TMSDateTime is null then '00:00' else ABC.Breaktime end) as Breaktime, case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) as STimeOUT, ETMS1.TerminalNo
from SET_DateTime
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID in @CompanyID) {3} and EP.Status = 1 and EP.IsActive = 1 {1} and EP.Status=1 left JOIN SET_JobDesignation ED ON ED.JobDesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
-- left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) --and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1 left join HRMS_AttendanceRoaster ES on ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status = 1 --and ES.ShiftFrom <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ShiftTo >= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND CONVERT(date,ES.ShiftFrom)=Convert(date,SET_DateTime.TheDate) left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1 and SS.IsActive = 1 LEFT join HRMS_Set_Shift ABC on SET_DateTime.THEDATE >= ABC.FromDate and SET_DateTime.THEDATE <= ABC.ToDate and ABC.Status=1 and ABC.IsActive = 1 left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.TMSDateTime)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate {0} ) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1 and PT.IsActive = 1
left join Set_Section on Set_Section.SectionID = fintab.FK_SectionID and Set_Section.Status =1 and Set_Section.IsActive = 1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = fintab.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1 and SET_Location.IsActive = 1 {2} group by TheDate, fintab.CompanyID,fintab.PersonID,fintab.PersonTypeCode,EmployeeCode,FullName,FatherName,DesignationName,IsOverTime,DepartmentName, IsHoliday,fintab.DayDescription,ShiftName,DataTypeIN,DataTypeOUT,ShiftTimeIN,ShiftTimeOUT,TerminalNo1,ShiftCode, TerminalNo2,STimeIN,STimeOUT,SectionName,LocationName,fintab.JoiningDate,fintab.Reason,fintab.Description,Breaktime ,fintab.IsNormalDay Order by TheDate,EmployeeCode,Month_Name

data.name: Query_LeaveLog
data.value:
----Declare @FromDate date ='2022-04-01 00:00:00' ,@ToDate date = '2022-01-30 23:59:59' ,@IsActive int =1, -- Declare ----@sDate DateTime,@eDate DateTime, --@PayrollTypeCOde int=4; ----select @sDate = @month, ---- @eDate = @month
Declare --@sDate DateTime,@eDate DateTime, @PayrollTypeCOde int=4;
Select --HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, --HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, TAB.FullName, TAB.FatherName, Tab.EmployeeCode, TAB.totalleaves , TAB.PersonID ,TAB.LeaveID ,TAB.PayrollTypeID ,TAB.PayrollTypeCode ,TAB.Description as LeaveTypeName, TAB.Opening, cast( isnull( SUM(TAB.Quantity),0) as int) AS Quantity, -- cast (isnull (TAB.leaveDays - SUM(QUANTITY),0 ) as int) as Balance
-- cast (isnull (TAB.leaveDays,0) as int) - cast( isnull( SUM(TAB.Quantity),0) as int) [Balance] cast (isnull (TAB.Opening,0) as int) - cast( isnull( SUM(TAB.Quantity),0) as int) [Balance], tab.locationname,tab.Availed,tab.FromDate,tab.ToDate,tab.DesignationName --,cast (isnull (TAB.Opening,0) as int) - cast( isnull( SUM(TAB.Quantity),0) as int) OPBal
from ( select distinct HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_LeaveLog.totalleaves ,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID as LeaveID , HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID ,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID ,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode ,HRMS_PayrollType.Description ,isnull(sum(HRMS_LeaveLog.totalleaves),0) as lavd --, isnull(sum((DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate, DATEADD(Day, 1, HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate)))), 0 )as diifd ,--isnull(sum(LeaveDays),0) - isnull(sum(HRMS_LeaveLog.totalleaves),0) - isnull(( select isnull(sum((DATEDIFF(DAY, HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate, DATEADD(Day, 1, HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate)))), 0 )as diifd from HRMS_LeaveRequest --inner join SET_PeriodCustom on HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate < @FromDate --SET_PeriodCustom.StartDate --and HRMS_LeaveRequest.ToDate <= SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate where HRMS_LeaveRequest.FK_PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_LeaveRequest.Fk_PersonID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID and HRMS_LeaveRequest.status = 1 and( cast (HRMS_LeaveRequest.FromDate as datetime) < @FromDate)
),0) as Opening ,isnull(sum(HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.Quantity),0) as Quantity, set_location.locationname,set_designation.DesignationName,HRMS_LeaveLog.Availed,HRMS_LeaveLog.FromDate,HRMS_LeaveLog.ToDate from HRMS_EmployeePayroll left join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.personID=HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 and HRMS_Set_Employee.IsActive = 1
left join HRMS_EmployeeAttendance on HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.PersonID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.LeaveID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.CompanyID and (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime is null or HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsOneTime=0) and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1 and( cast (HRMS_EmployeeAttendance.MonthYear as datetime) between @FromDate AND @ToDate)
inner join HRMS_PayrollType on --HRMS_PayrollType.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID --and HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID= HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.[Status] = 1 and HRMS_PayrollType.IsActive = 1
inner join HRMS_LeaveLog on HRMS_LeaveLog.CompanyID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID And HRMS_LeaveLog.FK_PersonID = HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID
inner join set_location on set_location.locationid = HRMS_Set_Employee.fk_locationid
inner join set_designation on set_designation.DesignationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID
WHERE HRMS_EmployeePayroll.CompanyID in @CompanyID --Edit {0} and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.Status = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.IsActive = 1 and HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode = @PayrollTypeCOde AND (HRMS_EmployeePayroll.FiscalID=@CurrentFiscalID OR @CurrentFiscalID is null)
group by HRMS_Set_Employee.FullName, HRMS_Set_Employee.FatherName, HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode, HRMS_LeaveLog.totalleaves, HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PersonID ,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID ,HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeID , HRMS_PayrollType.PayrollTypeCode ,HRMS_PayrollType.Description ,HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeID ,HRMS_EmployeePayroll.PayrollTypeCode ,set_location.locationname, set_designation.DesignationName, HRMS_LeaveLog.Availed, HRMS_LeaveLog.FromDate, HRMS_LeaveLog.ToDate
)TAB Group By TAB.FullName, TAB.FatherName, TAB.EmployeeCode, TAB.PersonID, TAB.LeaveID, TAB.PayrollTypeID, TAB.PayrollTypeCode, TAB.[Description], TAB.totalleaves, TAB.Opening, tab.locationname, tab.Availed, tab.FromDate, tab.ToDate, tab.DesignationName
order by tab.employeeCode asc, tab.FromDate asc
